items.title: ExxonMobil (XOM) Delivers Record Oil Output And Revenue On Lower Spending
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) recently reported record oil output and revenue achieved while keeping capital spending at lower levels. Management highlighted higher production from high-return assets such as the Permian Basin as a key driver of these records. The group indicated that technology and efficiency gains allowed it to sustain operations despite geopolitical risks affecting Middle East supply routes.
